_comment: Maps normalized error_type strings to lesson/skill IDs from lessons.json (IDs 1-25). Only error types with a clear, unambiguous Sanskrit competency mapping are included. See 'intentionally_unmapped' for types that are recognized but excluded from BKT until a valid mapping is decided.

intentionally_unmapped.agreement_error: Subject-verb and noun-adjective agreement errors span multiple skills (Vibhakti, Verbs, Pronouns). No single skill_id can be unambiguously assigned. Exclude from BKT until a compound skill is designed.
intentionally_unmapped.unknown_error: Input could not be attributed to a specific Sanskrit competency. No BKT update is performed. A description is still returned to the learner.
